question.text: Which section of the PPM provides year-wise illustration of fees and expenses charged by a Category III AIF scheme?

answer.text: Illustrations of Fees, Expenses and Other Charges

explanation.text: The Logic: The 'Illustrations of Fees, Expenses and Other Charges' section gives a year-wise illustration of net amount invested after fees and expenses. The Trap: Principal Terms describes fee structure conceptually; Distribution Waterfall covers cash flow to stakeholders; Disciplinary History tracks regulatory actions. Cross-Exam Context: Same PPM template section exists in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use this section in investor conversations as it makes the pre-fee vs post-fee NAV differential concrete.
